tagline: Find the Right Government Loan Scheme for You
taglineHi: अपने लिए सही सरकारी ऋण योजना खोजें

howSteps.1: Share a few details about yourself and your need
howSteps.2: See schemes that match published eligibility rules
howSteps.3: Estimate EMI and review required documents

whyPoints.1: Information linked to official government sources
whyPoints.2: Clear explanations — not just a score
whyPoints.4: Does not submit loan applications for you

transparency: Where does this information come from?
partnerExplain: Find authorized channel partners near you
partnerPrivacy: Your location is used only to find nearby eligible channel partners.
disclaimer: Information is compiled from official government sources and may change. The platform provides guidance and scheme matching based on the latest successfully verified information available to it. Final eligibility, sanction, interest rate, documentation requirements, and disbursement are subject to the applicable official rules and the authorized channel partner.
existingLoan: Do you have an existing loan?
autoLocationHelp: Fetches your GPS location and searches partners immediately.
manualLocationHelp: Uses only state / district / PIN. Does not use GPS coordinates.
mapHint: Interactive OpenStreetMap. Partner pins appear only when coordinates are available from an official source.
oneSearchMethod: Use only one search method at a time. Results always reflect your latest search.
locationDenied: Location permission denied. Use manual state/district search instead.
noGeoSupport: This browser does not support location. Use manual state/district search instead.
partnerFallbackNote: No nearby partners with map coordinates. Showing official partner listings for your area.
noPartners: No suitable partners found within the maximum search radius.
noGuarantee: You appear to meet the published eligibility criteria. Final approval is determined by the authorized channel partner.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
emptySchemes: No schemes are available yet. An administrator should run the official source scraper.
footerNote: YojanaSahayak — guidance only. Not a loan application portal.
matchingSchemesLead: These are guidance results based on published eligibility rules. This is not a loan approval.
noMatchLead: No published scheme currently fits your details. Closest options below explain exactly where you fall short.
topMatchesHint: Up to 10 best matches. The top 3 are shown in full below (match reasons + EMI). Options 4–10 are summarized.
emiConfirmNote: Estimated values only — confirm with the channel partner.
docsUnavailable: Document list is not available from the official source yet. Confirm with the channel partner.
findPartnerForScheme: Find channel partner for this scheme
closestSchemes: Closest scheme(s) — not available for you right now:
cannotAvailDetail: You cannot currently avail this scheme. Review the gaps below.
partnerLinkedNote: Partner search is linked to the scheme you selected above (Option {n}).
emiOnlyEligible: EMI estimate is shown only for schemes you appear eligible for.
emiTop3Only: Open one of the top 3 matches for a detailed EMI estimate.
guide1: Confirm eligibility on the official scheme page.
guide2: Find an authorized channel partner below.
guide3: Contact or visit the partner with your documents.
guide4: Ask the partner to confirm current scheme availability.
guide5: Complete the official application only through the partner.
sourceTextNote: Scheme name and description are shown as published by the official source (may be in English).
partnerOnlyAfterMatch: Partner search is available only after a scheme matches your published eligibility criteria.
